poll.q: Aaj ka sab se bara match: Pakistan vs England — kya hoga?
options: 🏏 Pakistan jeet kar final mein — Minhas phir chha jayega 🔥
🏴󐁧󐁢󐁥󐁮󐁧󐁿 England comeback — Brook ka bat phir chalega 💪
🌧️ Barish ya thriller — last over tak jayega 😬
🤖 Koi match nahi, AI ki khabrein hi kaafi hain — Gartner ka $4.9T gap 😱

https://www.reuters.com/technology/moons.what: Moonshot AI ne apne naye Kimi K3.1 Pro se cyber-attack wali training data nikaal di — model ab hacking tools banane mein pehle se kamzor hai. 3-trillion-parameter-class open-weights model ke weights 4 November tak public hon ge. Internal cyber benchmark pe filtered model ne 81% score kiya, unfiltered version ke 90.5% ke muqable. Ye tab ho raha hai jab China ne AI-driven malware-generation tools pe export controls propose kiye hain.
https://www.reuters.com/technology/moons.why: Open-weights models ka masla yehi hai: ek dafa weights public ho gaye to control wapas nahi aata. Moonshot ne ye samajh liya ke 'free aur powerful' ke saath 'free aur dangerous' bhi aa jata hai. Is liye company ne khud hi apne model ko thora kamzor kar diya — taake open-weights release ke baad koi us se frontier-level hacking tool na bana sake.
https://www.reuters.com/technology/moons.next: 4 November ko weights release ke baad dekhein community kya karti hai — kya filtered capabilities dobara 'unlearn' ho jati hain fine-tuning se? Agar haan, to ye poora exercise sirf PR tha. Agar nahi, to ye open-weights safety ka naya standard ban sakta hai.
https://www.reuters.com/technology/moons.take: Meri take: Chinese company ne apne model ko khud kamzor kar diya — aur ye smart hai, kamzori nahi. Open weights ka matlab hai model ab duniya ka hai, company ka nahi. Jab aap ko pata ho ke aap ka model kisi hacker ke haath bhi lag sakta hai, to us ki hacking power kam karna zimmedari hai. Baqi labs ko bhi yehi karna chahiye — lekin wo karenge nahi, kyunki benchmarks pe number kam ho jayenge. Moonshot ne number qurbaan kiye, izzat bachayi.

https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-t.what: Reuters ki exclusive reporting: Biden aur Trump dono administrations ne kai baar SpaceX se kaha ke Starlink ko mukhtalif mulkon mein on ya off kare — Yemen aur Lebanon mein Iranian proxies ka access band karne ke liye, aur Iran aur Ukraine mein protesters aur military ke liye service chalane ke liye. Ye requests pehle kabhi report nahi hui thin. Isi mahine Ukraine ke military Starshield access ko throttle karne ke baad ye sawal uth raha hai ke US foreign policy kitni ek private company ke haath mein hai.
https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-t.why: Ye khabar is liye bari hai kyunki ye 'Musk vs governments' ki kahani ko ulta kar deti hai. Musk sirf apni marzi se switches nahi daba raha — do American presidents us se switches dabane ko keh chuke hain. Matlab Starlink ab sirf ek company nahi, American foreign policy ka ek tool ban gaya hai, chahe koi isay officially mane ya na mane.
https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-t.next: Europe is report ke baad apna military satellite system banane ka pressure aur mehsoos karega — koi bhi mulk apni defence communications ek aadmi ki company pe nahi chhorna chahega. Congress mein bhi SpaceX pe oversight ki awazein tez hon gi.
https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-t.take: Meri take: ye woh khabar hai jo 'private company' aur 'state power' ke beech ki line ko mita deti hai. Ek taraf Biden ne kaha 'Houthis ka Starlink band karo', doosri taraf Trump ne kaha 'Iran mein on karo'. Musk ke haath mein ek aisa switch hai jo presidents ke paas hona chahiye tha. Aur jab Ukraine ka access throttle hua to sab ko achanak yaad aaya: yaar, humari army ka internet ek billionaire ke mood pe chal raha hai? Ye dependence khatarnak hai — aur sirf America ke liye nahi, har us mulk ke liye jo Starlink use karta hai.

https://www.reuters.com/commentary/break.what: Reuters Breakingviews ke mutabiq AI data-centre boom ab asli duniya ki deewaron se takra raha hai: grid-connection delays ki wajah se Microsoft ne UK mein neocloud Nscale ke saath lease chhor di, Australia mein local opposition ne NextDC ka Melbourne project rukwa diya, aur kai US states ne naye data centres pe moratoria laga diye. Neoclouds ki borrowing costs barh gayi hain, margins squeeze ho rahe hain. Lekin doosri taraf Musk kehta hai SpaceX ke paas end-2027 tak 13 gigawatts computing power hogi.
https://www.reuters.com/commentary/break.why: AI boom ka pehla sawaal tha 'kitne data centres chahiye?' — ab sawaal hai 'kya itne ban bhi sakte hain?' Bijli, zameen, aur local logon ki razamandi — ye teen cheezein GPUs se zyada slow hain. Jo companies pehle se built infrastructure rakhti hain, un ki value ab aur barhegi; jo sirf paper pe projects rakhti hain, un ki mushkil hogi.
https://www.reuters.com/commentary/break.next: Dekhna hoga ke neocloud financing ka crisis kitna gehra hota hai — CoreWeave jese players ke results batayenge ke ye speed-bump hai ya bubble ka pehla crack. Aur data-centre moratoria ka trend agar aur states mein phaila to AI costs ka poora hisaab badal jayega.
https://www.reuters.com/commentary/break.take: Meri take: AI ko bijli chahiye, aur bijli ki line mein lagna parta hai — ye woh boring sach hai jo hype mein kho gaya tha. Microsoft jesi company lease chhor de to samjho masla serious hai. Lekin Musk ka 13 gigawatts wala dawa bhi yaad rakho: jab sab kehte hain 'nahi ban sakta', tabhi koi ek kehta hai 'main bana lunga'. Data-centre race ab technology ki race se zyada bijli aur zameen ki race ban gayi hai.

https://www.crnasia.com/news/2026/cloud/.what: Gartner ki prediction: 2030 tak 80% se zyada neocloud providers independent nahi rahenge — ya to bik jayenge ya band ho jayenge. Wajah: AI infrastructure pe kharcha revenue se aage nikal gaya hai. 2026 mein AI providers taqreeban $1 trillion kharch karenge, aur 2030 tak mazeed $6 trillion — lekin data centres se mutalliq AI revenue zyada se zyada $3.6 trillion tak pahunchegi, jab ke $8.5 trillion chahiye hoga. Matlab $4.9 trillion ka gap.
https://www.crnasia.com/news/2026/cloud/.why: Ye AI bubble debate ka sab se solid number ab tak hai — guess nahi, Gartner ka model hai. Neoclouds sab se zyada exposed hain kyunki un ke paas hyperscalers jesa diversified revenue nahi: un ka ek hi business hai, GPU rent pe dena, aur wo business abhi paisa wapas nahi kar raha. CoreWeave ka Q2 2026 mein $640 million net interest expense is ki live misaal hai.
https://www.crnasia.com/news/2026/cloud/.next: 2030 tak consolidation wave aayegi — chhote neoclouds ya to hyperscalers ko bikenge ya sovereign cloud niches mein chhupenge. Investors ab 'growth at any cost' se nikal kar 'return on invested capital' poochna shuru kar denge.
https://www.crnasia.com/news/2026/cloud/.take: Meri take: $8.5 trillion chahiye, $3.6 trillion aayega — ye gap koi chhota mota accounting difference nahi, ye poori industry ka hisaab kharab hai. Lekin ye 'AI khatam' wali khabar bhi nahi hai. Internet bubble mein bhi aise hi 80% companies mari thin, aur internet phir bhi duniya badal gaya. Farq sirf ye hai: jo companies bachengi, wo wohi hon gi jin ke paas real revenue hai — baqi sab PowerPoint pe chal rahi thin. Hype mar sakta hai, technology nahi.

https://www.deccanherald.com/technology/.what: Is hafte ke gadget launches: HP ka ZBook Ultra G3a 16-inch workstation (AMD Ryzen AI Max+, 300B-parameter local LLMs chala sakta hai), Casio ki G-SHOCK 2500 series, Oura Ring 5 smart ring, Lenovo ke Yoga Pro 9n aur Yoga 9n 2-in-1, aur Sony ka ECM-AX10 — smartphones ke liye duniya ka pehla spatial audio microphone. Saath hi ye bhi ke Google Cloud customers ko ab OpenAI ke ChatGPT models ka access milega.
https://www.deccanherald.com/technology/.why: Laptop mein 300B-parameter model locally chalana 2 saal pehle sci-fi tha — ab workstation spec sheet hai. Is ka matlab AI ab cloud se nikal kar aap ki desk pe aa raha hai, aur 'local AI' ek real product category ban gayi hai. Oura Ring 5 aur spatial mic batate hain ke health aur creator hardware bhi AI-first ho raha hai.
https://www.deccanherald.com/technology/.next: Dekhna hoga ke local-LLM workstations ki qeemat kab aam developer ki range mein aati hai — abhi ye enterprise territory hai. Aur Google Cloud pe ChatGPT models ka aana batata hai ke cloud wars ab 'kis ka model' se zyada 'kis ka platform' ki fight hai.
https://www.deccanherald.com/technology/.take: Meri take: aap ke laptop mein 300 billion parameters — socho, 2 saal pehle ye poora data centre chahiye tha. Ye woh shift hai jo chup-chap ho rahi hai: AI ab aap ke device mein aa raha hai, cloud pe nahi. Lekin price dekh ke hansi bhi aati hai — ye workstation aap ki salary ka ek hissa kha jayega. Technology democratize ho rahi hai, qeemat abhi nahi.

https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/nebenw.what: HCLTech ne 21 October ko NVIDIA-powered software-defined vehicle validation offering launch ki — agentic AI, physical AI simulation aur intelligent orchestration, Omniverse, Cosmos, Alpamayo aur Isaac Sim ke saath. Is se pehle Q2 mein $3.3 billion ki new deal bookings aayi thin, 27% up year over year. Lekin LKP Research ne Hold rating rakhi aur Rs 1,360 target diya, slow organic growth aur weak discretionary spending ki wajah se.
https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/nebenw.why: Indian IT giants ab 'AI services' se aage barh kar 'physical AI' mein ja rahe hain — gaariyon ki validation jese industrial use cases. Ye pivot important hai kyunki traditional IT services ki growth slow ho gayi hai, aur agentic/physical AI hi naya growth engine hai. Lekin analysts abhi bhi cautious hain — launch aur revenue mein farq hota hai.
https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/nebenw.next: 26 October ko HCLTech ka INR 12 interim dividend pay hoga. Asal test ye hoga ke NVIDIA wali offering kitne real contracts mein convert hoti hai — announcements se balance sheet nahi banti.
https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/nebenw.take: Meri take: Indian IT ka naya mantra — 'AI se gaari test karo'. HCLTech ne NVIDIA ke saath mil kar physical AI mein qadam rakha hai, aur ye direction sahi hai. Lekin analyst ka Hold rating bhi ghalat nahi: har AI launch revenue nahi hota. Pakistani IT companies ke liye lesson: agentic AI aur physical AI sirf buzzwords nahi, ye woh areas hain jahan agle 5 saal ke contracts banenge. Seekhna shuru karo, warna pitch mein sirf 'web development' reh jayega.

https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/sports.what: Aaj Sunday ko Lahore ke Gaddafi Stadium mein Pakistan aur England ka tri-series ka chautha match hai (1:00 PM PKT). Pakistan ne ab tak dono matches jeete hain — Sri Lanka se 37 runs aur England se 87 runs — aur aaj jeet final ki ticket pakki kar degi. England ne dono matches haare hain, Sri Lanka ke khilaaf 430 ka target bhi defend nahi kar paye. Pehle match mein Arafat Minhas ne 6 wickets liye the.
https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/sports.why: Ye match sirf ek game nahi — ye final ka darwaza hai. Pakistan ke paas form hai, crowd hai, aur Gaddafi Stadium ka home advantage hai. England ke paas doosra koi option nahi: jeeto ya ghar jao wali situation. Harry Brook ki double-hundred wali form aur Minhas ki spin — ye do cheezein match decide karengi.
https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/sports.next: Aaj ka result poori series ka shape badal dega: Pakistan jeeta to final mein, England jeeta to table khul jayega aur Sri Lanka wala match do-or-die ban jayega. Final 31 October ko isi ground pe hai.
https://www.newsbytesapp.com/news/sports.take: Meri take: Lahore mein Sunday, England ke khilaaf, final ki ticket daao pe — is se behtar cricket Sunday kya ho sakta hai? Pakistan form mein hai, Minhas ne pehle match mein England ko 6 wickets se rulaya tha, aur crowd ka shor Gaddafi mein alag hi hota hai. Bas ek guzarish: jeet ke baad overconfidence mat dikhana, final abhi baki hai. Pehle ticket pakki karo, phir celebration.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2039654.what: Azerbaijan mein Pakistan ke FIFA U-15 World Cup debut mein Shaheens ne 2-0 ki lead zaya kar di aur Gambia se 4-2 haar gaye. Ameer Hamza ne paanchve minute mein tournament ka pehla goal kiya aur Baxi Hamal Khan ne lead double ki — lekin half-time se pehle Gambia ne ek goal wapas kiya aur second half mein teen aur kar ke match palat diya.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039654.why: Ye haar bhi ek milestone hai: Pakistan pehli baar is level pe khel raha hai. 2-0 ki lead se haarne ka dard alag hai — ye experience ki kami ka result hai, talent ki nahi. U-15 level pe yehi matches seekhne ka kaam karte hain: lead ko defend karna bhi ek skill hai, aur ye skill sirf aise matches se aati hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039654.next: Group ke agle matches mein dekhna hoga ke team is collapse se seekh kar wapas aati hai ya confidence toot jata hai. Youth football mein ek haar tournament khatam nahi karti — lekin ek hi ghalti dohrana zaroor khatam kar deta hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039654.take: Meri take: 2-0 se 4-2 — ye woh haar hai jo raat ko neend nahi aane deti. Lekin suno: Pakistan U-15 World Cup pe khel raha hai, ye khud ek bari baat hai. Hamza ka pehla goal tournament ka pehla goal tha — ye history hai. Haar ka dard hai, lekin ye team abhi bachon ki hai, aur bachon se seekhne ki umeed hoti hai, perfection ki nahi. Agle match mein lead defend karna seekhna hai — bas.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2039610/gabd-b.what: Pakistan ne Saturday ko Iran ke saath Gabd-Rimdan border crossing dobara khol di — ek hafte ki bandish ke baad jo 17 October se lagi thi. Gate 250 (Gwadar) se LPG aur essential food items ke stranded trucks ko guzarne diya gaya. Traders ko umeed hai ke is se mulk bhar mein LPG shortage aur barhti energy/food prices mein kami aayegi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039610/gabd-b.why: Border ek hafte band raha to poora mulk mehsoos karta hai — LPG ki qeemat, food supply, transporters ki rozi. Ye khabar is liye important hai kyunki ye 'diplomacy' nahi, aam aadmi ke kitchen tak ka masla hai. Thursday ko stranded trucks pe hamla bhi hua tha — border trade ki security bhi ek sawal hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039610/gabd-b.next: Dekhna hoga ke crossing mustaqil khuli rehti hai ya dobara band hoti hai — aur Taftan crossing ka kya banta hai, jo isi order mein band hui thi. LPG prices agle hafte batayenge ke relief real hai ya sirf announcement.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039610/gabd-b.take: Meri take: border khul gaya, trucks chal pare — aur aam aadmi ko sirf yehi chahiye hota hai ke cheezein pohanch jayen, qeematein neeche aayen. Ek hafte ki bandish ne LPG ko aag laga di thi. Ab jab crossing khuli hai to umeed hai ke LPG sasta ho — lekin yaad rakho, border trade jab politics ki bhet charhta hai to bill humesha ghareeb bharta hai. Khula rakho, bas.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2039580/nasira.what: Nasirabad district mein Dera Murad Jamali ke qareeb 220kV transmission pylon ko IED se ura diya gaya early Saturday — is se Sindh aur Punjab ke kai ilaqon (Shikarpur, Rahim Yar Khan, Sadiqabad, Sukkur, Larkana, Jacobabad, Kashmore, Guddu) ki bijli mutasir hui, jo Uch Power Plant se aati hai. Kisi group ne zimmedari nahi li, aur repairs security clearance ke baad shuru hon gi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039580/nasira.why: Ek pylon girao to 8 shehron ki bijli jati hai — ye humari grid ki fragility ka sab se seedha saboot hai. Transmission infrastructure soft target hai, aur is ka nuksan seedha gharon, hospitals aur karobar ko hota hai. Investigation aur repairs ka waqt bhi important hai: jitni der bijli band, utna nuksan.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039580/nasira.next: Security clearance ke baad repairs kitni jaldi hoti hain, ye dekhna hoga — aur kya ye isolated attack tha ya pattern ka hissa. Grid security pe ab sirf police statement nahi, concrete plan chahiye.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039580/nasira.take: Meri take: ek dhamaka, 8 sheher andhere mein — ye koi film ka scene nahi, humari grid ki haqeeqat hai. Pylon bomb se urana aasan hai, dobara khara karna mushkil — aur beech mein awam bijli ke baghair baithi rehti hai. Har baar yehi hota hai: attack, statement, search operation — aur agle mahine phir wohi. Grid ko harden karne ka waqt kab aayega? Jab tak sirf statements aayenge, pylon girte rahenge.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2039586.what: Wapda ne Saturday ko Diamer-Bhasha Dam ke liye Rs133.18 billion ka hydro-mechanical (HM-1) contract sign kiya Power China-IKAN Joint Venture ke saath — gates, steel structures, flushing tunnels, power intakes aur dam outlets ka kaam. Dam Indus pe Chilas se 40km neeche ban raha hai; mukammal hone pe 8.1 million acre-feet pani store karega aur 4,500 megawatts bijli dega.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039586.why: Diamer-Bhasha Pakistan ki water, food aur energy security ka sab se bara single project hai — decades se talk mein hai, ab contracts sign ho rahe hain. HM-1 jese heavy contracts ka sign hona batata hai ke project paper se zameen pe aa raha hai. Lekin asal test completion timeline hai, jo Pakistani mega-projects mein humesha slip hoti hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039586.next: Equipment manufacturing aur installation ka schedule dekhna hoga — aur cost overruns pe nazar rakhni hogi. Dam ki completion tak pani ki kami aur bijli ka crisis dono chalenge, is liye har saal ki delay ki qeemat hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039586.take: Meri take: Rs133 billion ka contract sign ho gaya — Diamer-Bhasha ab sirf PowerPoint nahi raha. 4,500 megawatts aur 8.1 million acre-feet — ye numbers Pakistan ki mustaqbil ki lifeline hain. Lekin Pakistani mega-project ki history dekh ke dil mein ek sawaal zaroor aata hai: ye dam humari zindagi mein mukammal hoga ya hamare bachon ki? Contract sign karna achi khabar hai, dam chalana asli khabar hogi.

https://www.dawn.com/news/2039569/talks-.what: Pakistan aur Canada ne Bilateral Investment Treaty pe teesre round ki negotiations Saturday ko mukammal kar li — Board of Investment ke mutabiq significant progress hui hai. Baat-cheet mein direct/indirect investments, portfolio investments, performance requirements, expropriation, third-party funding aur investor-state dispute settlement shamil the. Treaty se investor confidence aur business opportunities barhne ki umeed hai.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039569/talks-.why: Investment treaty boring lagta hai, lekin ye woh paperwork hai jis se foreign investor ko yaqeen aata hai ke us ka paisa mehfooz hai. Pakistan ko investment chahiye to aise treaties ki zaroorat hai — bina legal certainty ke koi bara investor nahi aata. Canada ke saath ye treaty diaspora business links ko bhi formalize karegi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039569/talks-.next: Treaty ka final text aur signing timeline dekhni hogi — teesra round progress hai, conclusion nahi. Asal impact tab aayega jab Canadian companies Pakistan mein invest karna shuru karengi, sirf MOU sign karne se nahi.
https://www.dawn.com/news/2039569/talks-.take: Meri take: investment treaty ki khabar sun ke koi khushi se nahi uchhalta — lekin yehi woh boring kaam hai jo mulk ko paisa dilata hai. Investor ko pehle ye yaqeen chahiye ke us ka paisa dispute mein phasay ga nahi, phir wo factory lagayega. Canada ke saath teesra round mukammal — acha signal hai, lekin signal se salary nahi banti. Jab Canadian investment zameen pe nazar aaye to mubarakbad banti hai.

mood: Sunday mood: Gaddafi mein England ke khilaaf final ki ticket daao pe, Kimi ne apni hacking power khud kam kar di, Gartner ne AI ke $4.9T gap ka bomb phora — aur Gabd border khulne se LPG ki umeed jaagi 🏏🤖🇵🇰
